apps.localizedDescription: Garden Hour 08 is an offline cocktail recipe app with three recipes: Mojito, Gin Basil Smash and Cucumber Collins. Each shows ingredient quantities, preparation time, glass type and numbered steps, and Surprise Me picks a recipe different from the one you opened last.
